name: br.com.mrocigno.bigbrother.core.BigBrotherWatchTask
description: This is part of Mrocigno's BigBrother diagnostic toolkit. When BigBrother monitoring is enabled, it places a floating shortcut on app screens so users can open the diagnostic panel.
disableEffect: The BigBrother floating shortcut and its diagnostic panel will disappear; normal app screens will continue to work.
